companyDescription: Complement (C1q) platform · vonaprument (ANX007) Phase 3 ARCHER II in geographic atrophy — the first GA program targeting vision loss (BCVA) rather than lesion growth; tanruprubart BLA in GBS also due Q4
priceNote: Live $4.21 (+0.5%) on Nov 11, 2026. The 52-week range is $2.54–$7.18. Market cap is ~$860M (~204M shares). The tape is risk-off after the hot Oct CPI (Nov 10), with Dec 9 hike odds at ~89–100%.
summary: The binary is the Month-15 primary-endpoint assessment of ARCHER II (659 patients, vonaprument vs sham, primary endpoint ≥15-letter BCVA loss), guided to Q4 2026 by an independent DMC. In Phase 2 ARCHER, monthly dosing showed a 72% reduction in the risk of 15-letter loss (p=0.006), and no approved GA drug has shown a vision benefit. H.C. Wainwright ($25) puts fair value near $44 at 90% PoS after a positive readout, against ~$4 today; consensus is ~$17. Cash of $213M runs into 2028, so there is no survival flag. phase3_readout has n<5 in the feedback file, so it is context only. Base +100% (~$8.4) is a 1–3 month post-readout re-rating. That is far above the lane's realized 30d P75 (+12.2%; Base bias +72.7pp), so it is a post-data horizon, not a 30-day call. If Month 15 misses, the trial continues to Month 24, which softens but does not remove a ~50–60% gap-down. แนะนำ 2–3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50–80%.

catalysts.name: ARCHER II Month-15 primary endpoint (DMC assessment)
catalysts.description: An independent DMC assesses the primary endpoint (≥15-letter BCVA loss) at Month 15 in 659 GA patients. If it is met, sub-study analyses follow in Q1 2027. If not, the trial continues to the Month-24 dual primary. The company guides to Q4 2026 with no exact day.

catalysts.name: Tanruprubart BLA submission — Guillain-Barré syndrome
catalysts.description: A second shot on goal: Annexon guides to a US BLA for tanruprubart in GBS in Q4 2026. A filing would be the company's first potential commercial product.

risks: Binary Month-15 readout. Phase 2 ARCHER hit on vision but missed on lesion-growth reduction, so a single Phase 3 could disappoint on effect size even if it is technically positive.
No exact date: "Q4 2026" could slip into early 2027, and a DMC-driven readout can arrive with little warning.
GA is a crowded market with incumbents (Apellis Syfovre, Astellas Izervay). The Syfovre safety scare (Jul 2023, ~-38%) shows how fast intravitreal sentiment can turn.
Expect a large equity raise into strength after positive data, which caps the first-day move.
Macro: a hot-CPI, rate-hike tape hits small-cap biotech multiples (XBI/IWM) before the readout.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Pre-revenue ophthalmology biotech. The ARCHER II readout dominates. Rates matter only through small-cap biotech risk appetite and the price of the post-data raise.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the December hike is priced. A Dec 9 50bp surprise or a hot Nov 25 PCE would hit small-cap biotech before a Q4 readout, which is why the dip entry is preferred.

Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: GA small caps tend to run into pivotal readouts. ISEE gained before GATHER2, and ANNX already rerated from ~$2.5 to $7 in 2026 on analyst PoS upgrades before giving most of it back. There is no fresh run-up yet.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: Final 2–4 weeks before the DMC assessment

postWin.note: ISEE (Iveric) on GATHER2 GA Phase 3 topline: opened ~+33%, closed ~+66% on the day (Zacks), and ~+86% for the week (Motley Fool). ANNX is smaller and more depressed, so the upside is plausibly larger.

postLose.note: APLS fell ~38% in a day on a GA safety signal (Jul 2023). ALLK fell ~88% when a Phase 2/3 missed its symptom endpoints (Dec 2021). A Month-15 miss with a Month-24 continuation likely lands in between.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If the Month-15 endpoint misses, exit day 1. The Month-24 continuation is not a reason to hold through a ~50%+ gap.

comparableCases.note: Same indication, same pivotal-readout shape. This is the template for an ANNX win, though ANNX's BCVA endpoint is more differentiated than lesion growth.
GA intravitreal sentiment can reverse in a day. This is the downside shape for any safety surprise in ARCHER II.
Worst-case template: hitting a biomarker but missing the clinical endpoint wipes out a single-asset small cap.

th.summary: ตัวชี้ขาดคือผลประเมิน endpoint หลักที่เดือน 15 ของ ARCHER II (659 ราย, vonaprument เทียบ sham, endpoint คือสูญเสียการมองเห็น ≥15 ตัวอักษร) โดย DMC อิสระ คาดภายใน Q4 2026 ใน Phase 2 การให้ยารายเดือนลดความเสี่ยงสูญเสีย 15 ตัวอักษรได้ 72% (p=0.006) และยังไม่มียา GA ที่อนุมัติแล้วตัวไหนแสดงประโยชน์ด้านการมองเห็น H.C. Wainwright (เป้า $25) ประเมินมูลค่ายุติธรรม ~$44 ถ้าผลบวก (PoS 90%) เทียบกับราคา ~$4 ตอนนี้ consensus ~$17 เงินสด $213M ใช้ได้ถึงปี 2028 จึงไม่ติด survival flag phase3_readout มี n<5 ในไฟล์ feedback ใช้เป็นบริบทเท่านั้น Base +100% (~$8.4) คือการ re-rate 1–3 เดือนหลังผล สูงกว่า P75 30 วันจริงของกลุ่มมาก (+12.2%; bias +72.7pp) จึงเป็นกรอบเวลาหลังผล ไม่ใช่คาด 30 วัน ถ้าเดือน 15 ไม่ผ่าน การศึกษาจะเดินต่อถึงเดือน 24 ซึ่งช่วยลดแรงตกได้บ้าง แต่ยังอาจ gap ลง ~50–60% แนะนำ 2–3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50–80%
th.priceNote: ราคาสด $4.21 (+0.5%) 11 พ.ย. 2026 ช่วง 52 สัปดาห์ $2.54–$7.18 Market cap ~$860M (~204M หุ้น) ตลาดอยู่ในโหมดระวังความเสี่ยงหลัง CPI ต.ค. ร้อน (10 พ.ย.) และตลาดให้โอกาสขึ้นดอกเบี้ย 9 ธ.ค. ~89–100%
